title: Uncertainty about features, faults, and documentation
summary: This topic centers on customers expressing uncertainty about whether issues are real defects, how specific features behave, and whether service concerns were documented correctly.

positive.summary: Positive-coded examples still describe hesitation about recommending or repurchasing the vehicle, so the concrete theme is customer doubt rather than praise.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention uncertainty around a possible defect and concern that a trunk issue may not have been documented properly.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples span unclear range expectations, possible glitches, confusion about parking and mirror controls, ambiguity in driver-assistance behavior, and difficulty selecting the intended parking space.

limitations: Most examples are classified as undetermined, which limits confidence in a clear sentiment reading for the topic.
The cluster mixes several unrelated uncertainty themes, including service documentation, range understanding, parking aids, mirror controls, and driver-assistance behavior.
Some positive-coded examples contain negative wording, so the supplied sentiment labels and fragment text are not fully aligned.
